SUBJECT: One men's single-breasted two-button suit jacket laid flat and neatly pressed, fastened at the top button, notch lapels of standard 8 cm width that roll softly to the top button, a welt breast pocket on the wearer's left chest, two straight flap hip pockets, four non-working cuff buttons on each sleeve, natural shoulders, sleeves lying straight down alongside the body, jacket long enough to cover the seat. Below the button the fronts open in a clean rounded cutaway. Inside the V-opening show the jacket interior: the inside back collar with a small hanger loop and the emerald green satin lining. Directly below the jacket, with a clear white gap, the matching trousers folded once lengthwise and laid horizontally, waistband to the right: show the outside of one leg with belt loops, a waistband button with extension, a slanted front side pocket, one jetted back pocket with a button, a sharp pressed crease running the full length, and plain finished hems with NO turn-ups. The jacket fills the upper 62% of the frame, the trousers the lower 30%, generous even white margins all round.

hero/slide-1.prompt: Premium editorial fashion photograph for a luxury bespoke tailoring house's website hero. Vertical 4:5 frame. Plain seamless studio backdrop in a clean, flat, neutral light grey (#EEEEEE) with no colour cast, no warmth, no beige, no gradient, no vignette. Large soft key light from the front-left with an even fill, bright and clean like a premium e-commerce studio, only a faint soft shadow beside the model, no harsh shadows. Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, eye level, tack-sharp on the suit and face, true-to-life skin texture, natural colour, no retouching artefacts. The model stands centred in the frame, framed from the top of the head to mid-thigh, with at least 8% empty backdrop above the head and on both sides so the image can be cropped to a square without cutting the head or the suit. The suit fits impeccably: clean shoulder line, lapels lying flat, sleeves showing a quarter inch of shirt cuff, jacket skimming the waist, trousers with a crisp crease. Calm, confident, understated expression; relaxed natural pose. No text, no logos, no props, no jewellery except a simple watch. Photorealistic, high-end, not illustrative. MODEL: a Black African man in his early thirties, deep brown skin, short neat hair, clean-shaven. SUIT: a midnight navy Super 120s wool three-piece — single-breasted two-button jacket with notch lapels unbuttoned to show a matching five-button waistcoat — white poplin shirt, burgundy silk tie, white linen pocket square in a straight fold. One hand relaxed at his side, the other lightly in his trouser pocket.
